themes: The story unfolds over a single day or night
All set in New York City
All shot on a single set

films.title: Die Hard
films.clue: Bruce Willis's New York cop crashes his estranged wife's office Christmas party in a Los Angeles skyscraper, barefoot.
films.why: One Christmas Eve inside Nakatomi Plaza.

films.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
films.clue: John Hughes comedy in which a Chicago teenager fakes an illness, borrows a Ferrari and hijacks a parade float.
films.why: One skipped school day in Chicago.

films.title: Training Day
films.clue: Denzel Washington won his Best Actor Oscar as a corrupt LA narcotics detective breaking in a rookie played by Ethan Hawke.
films.why: The rookie's first, and only, day on the job.

films.title: Before Sunrise
films.clue: Richard Linklater romance: an American and a French student meet on a train and wander Vienna until his flight home.
films.why: One night walking around Vienna.

films.title: Do the Right Thing
films.clue: Spike Lee writes, directs and plays pizza delivery man Mookie on a Brooklyn block during a heatwave.
films.why: The hottest day of the summer.

films.title: 12 Angry Men
films.clue: Henry Fonda is the lone juror holding out for 'not guilty' in a sweltering jury room.
films.why: One afternoon of jury deliberation.

themes: All scored by composer John Williams
All won the Oscar for Best Visual Effects

films.title: Jaws
films.clue: The mechanical star of this 1975 blockbuster was nicknamed Bruce, and kept breaking down in the waters off Martha's Vineyard.
films.why: Two notes were enough to win Williams an Oscar.

films.title: Star Wars
films.clue: Its opening crawl begins 'It is a period of civil war', and Alec Guinness earned an Oscar nomination as an ageing hermit.
films.why: The most famous Williams fanfare of all.

films.title: Home Alone
films.clue: Eight-year-old Kevin defends his suburban Chicago house from the 'Wet Bandits' at Christmas.
films.why: Williams wrote 'Somewhere in My Memory' for it.

films.title: Jurassic Park
films.clue: Based on a Michael Crichton novel, in which Richard Attenborough's tycoon 'spared no expense' on an island attraction.
films.why: Williams scored it the same year as Schindler's List.

films.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
films.clue: Chris Columbus directed this first trip to a British boarding school reached from Platform 9¾.
options: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
films.why: Williams wrote 'Hedwig's Theme', used across the series.

films.title: Superman
films.clue: Christopher Reeve's first outing in the cape; the poster promised 'You'll believe a man can fly'.
films.why: Its march is another Williams signature.

themes: All built around a heist or robbery

films.title: Heat
films.clue: Michael Mann crime epic that put Al Pacino and Robert De Niro in a scene together for the first time, over coffee.
films.why: De Niro's crew plans one last bank job.

films.title: Inception
films.clue: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a team into a sleeping heir's mind; a spinning top has kept audiences arguing ever since.
films.why: A heist in reverse: breaking in to plant an idea.

films.title: The Italian Job
films.clue: Michael Caine, three Mini Coopers and a Turin traffic jam: 'You're only supposed to blow the bloody doors off!'
films.why: A gold bullion robbery in Turin.

films.title: Baby Driver
films.clue: Edgar Wright action film whose getaway driver, played by Ansel Elgort, times every chase to his iPod playlist.
films.why: One getaway job after another.

films.title: Inside Man
films.clue: Spike Lee thriller: Denzel Washington negotiates with Clive Owen, whose crew has sealed off a Manhattan bank.
films.why: The 'perfect' bank robbery.

films.title: Point Break
films.clue: Kathryn Bigelow sends FBI agent Keanu Reeves undercover among surfers who wear ex-presidents masks to work.
films.why: The surfers fund their summers by robbing banks.

themes: All based on stories by Stephen King

films.title: The Shining
films.clue: Stanley Kubrick strands Jack Nicholson as the winter caretaker of the Overlook Hotel.
films.why: From King's 1977 novel. He famously disliked the film.

films.title: Stand by Me
films.clue: Four boys in 1959 Oregon follow the railway tracks to find a dead body; Richard Dreyfuss narrates.
films.why: From King's novella 'The Body'.

films.title: The Shawshank Redemption
films.clue: Tim Robbins's banker spends two decades in a Maine prison with a rock hammer and a Rita Hayworth poster.
films.why: From King's novella 'Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption'.

films.title: Misery
films.clue: Kathy Bates won an Oscar as the 'number one fan' who rescues a novelist from a car wreck.
options: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
films.why: From King's 1987 novel.

films.title: Carrie
films.clue: Brian De Palma horror starring Sissy Spacek, ending in cinema's most disastrous prom night.
films.why: From King's first published novel.

films.title: The Green Mile
films.clue: Tom Hanks is a Depression-era death-row guard who meets a gentle giant with a healing gift.
films.why: From King's six-part serial novel.

themes: All shot in black and white
All told out of chronological order
All won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay

films.title: Pulp Fiction
films.clue: Palme d'Or winner featuring a glowing briefcase, a five-dollar milkshake and a twist contest at Jack Rabbit Slim's.
films.why: Its three stories are shuffled, and it ends in the middle.

films.title: Memento
films.clue: Guy Pearce hunts his wife's killer using Polaroids and tattoos, because he can't form new memories.
films.why: Its colour scenes run backwards.

films.title: (500) Days of Summer
films.clue: Joseph Gordon-Levitt's greeting-card writer falls for Zooey Deschanel; the narrator warns 'this is not a love story'.
films.why: It jumps around the 500 days by number.

films.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
films.clue: Charlie Kaufman script in which Jim Carrey hires a firm called Lacuna to wipe Kate Winslet from his memory.
options: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
films.why: The romance plays in reverse as memories are erased.

films.title: Dunkirk
films.clue: A 2017 account of a 1940 evacuation, told from land, sea and air with very little dialogue.
films.why: A week, a day and an hour are interwoven.

films.title: Citizen Kane
films.clue: Orson Welles's first film, in which a reporter tries to decode a dying tycoon's last word.
films.why: A life pieced together from overlapping flashbacks.

films.title: The Departed
films.clue: Martin Scorsese finally won his directing Oscar for this Boston tale of a mole in the police and a mole in the mob.
films.why: A remake of Hong Kong's Infernal Affairs (2002).

films.title: Ocean's Eleven
films.clue: Steven Soderbergh sends George Clooney and Brad Pitt after three Las Vegas casinos in one night.
films.why: A remake of the 1960 Rat Pack film.

films.title: Scarface
films.clue: Al Pacino's Cuban refugee rises through Miami's cocaine trade: 'Say hello to my little friend!'
films.why: A remake of Howard Hawks's 1932 gangster film.

films.title: The Birdcage
films.clue: Robin Williams and Nathan Lane run a South Beach drag club and must impress a conservative senator played by Gene Hackman.
options: To Wong Foo, Thanks for Everything! Julie Newmar
films.why: A remake of La Cage aux Folles (1978).

films.title: A Star Is Born
films.clue: Bradley Cooper's first film as director, with Lady Gaga singing the Oscar-winning 'Shallow'.
films.why: The fourth version of a story first filmed in 1937.

films.title: The Fly
films.clue: David Cronenberg body horror: Jeff Goldblum's scientist tests his teleportation pods on himself. 'Be afraid. Be very afraid.'
films.why: A remake of the 1958 Vincent Price film.

themes: One actor plays more than one character

films.title: Dr. Strangelove
films.clue: Stanley Kubrick's Cold War satire: 'Gentlemen, you can't fight in here! This is the War Room!'
films.why: Peter Sellers plays three roles.

films.title: The Nutty Professor
films.clue: Eddie Murphy's Professor Sherman Klump invents a slimming formula and unleashes Buddy Love.
films.why: Murphy plays seven characters, including most of the Klump family.

films.title: The Parent Trap
films.clue: Nancy Meyers's first film as director: two girls meet at summer camp and plot to reunite their divorced parents.
films.why: Lindsay Lohan plays both twins.

films.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
films.clue: A cryogenically frozen 1960s British spy thaws in the '90s to face a villain demanding 'one million dollars'.
options: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
films.why: Mike Myers plays both Austin and Dr. Evil.

films.title: The Social Network
films.clue: David Fincher and Aaron Sorkin's account of a Harvard dorm-room startup and the lawsuits that followed.
films.why: Armie Hammer plays both Winklevoss twins.

films.title: Back to the Future Part II
films.clue: Sequel featuring hoverboards, self-lacing sneakers and a sports almanac, set partly in 2015.
options: Back to the Future Part II
films.why: Michael J. Fox plays Marty, his son and his daughter.

themes: All set at Thanksgiving or Christmas

films.title: Little Miss Sunshine
films.clue: A family pushes a broken yellow VW bus towards a California children's beauty pageant; Alan Arkin won an Oscar.
films.why: Albuquerque to Redondo Beach by VW bus.

films.title: Thelma & Louise
films.clue: Ridley Scott directs Geena Davis and Susan Sarandon in a 1966 Thunderbird, with an early role for Brad Pitt.
films.why: A weekend getaway that turns into a run for Mexico.

films.title: Rain Man
films.clue: Best Picture winner: Tom Cruise discovers a brother who refuses to fly and must be back in time for Judge Wapner.
films.why: Cincinnati to Los Angeles in a 1949 Buick.

films.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
films.clue: Steve Martin just wants to get home to Chicago for Thanksgiving; John Candy sells shower curtain rings.
films.why: New York to Chicago, the long way.

films.title: Dumb and Dumber
films.clue: Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels drive a dog-shaped van to Aspen to return a briefcase.
films.why: Providence to Aspen in the Mutt Cutts van.

films.title: Green Book
films.clue: Best Picture winner with Viggo Mortensen as a bouncer chauffeuring pianist Mahershala Ali in 1962.
films.why: A concert tour through the Deep South.

themes: All set in New York City
Set almost entirely in one location
All have a single credited actor

films.title: Rear Window
films.clue: Hitchcock thriller: James Stewart, laid up with a broken leg, passes the time watching his neighbours through a telephoto lens.
films.why: We never leave the apartment and its courtyard.

films.title: The Breakfast Club
films.clue: A brain, an athlete, a basket case, a princess and a criminal serve Saturday detention.
films.why: One school library.

films.title: Panic Room
films.clue: David Fincher thriller with Jodie Foster and a young Kristen Stewart hiding from burglars in their new Manhattan home.
films.why: One brownstone, mostly one room.

films.title: Phone Booth
films.clue: Colin Farrell answers a ringing public phone in Manhattan and is told he'll be shot if he hangs up.
films.why: One phone booth on 53rd Street.

films.title: Clue
films.clue: Tim Curry's butler hosts a murderous dinner party in this comedy based on a board game, released with three different endings.
films.why: One mansion on a stormy night.

films.title: Buried
films.clue: Ryan Reynolds is the only actor on screen: a truck driver in Iraq who wakes up underground with a mobile phone.
films.why: One coffin, for the entire running time.

themes: There's a number in every title

films.title: Se7en
films.clue: David Fincher's rain-soaked thriller with Brad Pitt and Morgan Freeman: 'What's in the box?'
films.why: Seven.

films.title: The Sixth Sense
films.clue: M. Night Shyamalan's breakthrough: 'I see dead people.'
films.why: Six.

films.title: Apollo 13
films.clue: Ron Howard dramatises a 1970 NASA mission: 'Houston, we have a problem.'
films.why: Thirteen.

films.title: District 9
films.clue: Neill Blomkamp's first feature: stranded aliens nicknamed 'prawns' are confined to a Johannesburg camp.
films.why: Nine.

films.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
films.clue: Stanley Kubrick science fiction: 'I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.'
films.why: Two thousand and one.

films.title: 8 Mile
films.clue: Eminem plays a Detroit factory worker in rap battles; 'Lose Yourself' won the Oscar.
films.why: Eight.
